unit: One new native Isaac process, two ordered parts without resetting the result latch. Pair controllers by sequence and physical placement schedule.
placement_definition: XY translation from the indexed belt's nominal underside center (-440,-248,899) mm. Pose stays axis-aligned at issue. The actual part must settle before pickup. These fixed schedules are design points, not random samples; compare P1/P2 and the two signs separately.
scheduled_order: Sequence in declared order. Within each sequence run profile A then B. Alternate controller order per successive sequence-profile pair, normal then stale first. Each arm is a fresh native process.
virtual_hardware: Native CPU-TGS PhysX under gravity, 120 Hz; pose and carry readout 30 Hz. Robot achieves a joint-limited kinematic path; the acquired payload has a virtual translational attachment, free contact settlement upon release. A one-slot output tray is externally emptied after the first settled output without resetting the latch.
primary_endpoints: Reference: both physical bins match the independent bracket-local geometry verdict, and both consumed result IDs match the part being routed, in all 12 pairs.

Stale OK: both profiles of each good-to-bad sequence physically false-accept the second bracket; stale ID is P1. NG-to-OK and NG-to-NG do not activate stale-OK on P2. OK-to-OK consumes P1's result while physical classification remains correct.
Both controllers: each settled output must be reconstructed from actual recorded part footprint, pose, final speed and support height rather than command/label alone.

Both controllers: independent replay of every recorded TCP/body pose and probe raycast, reference mesh height, correct registered geometry and infeed offsets. Four acquisitions and four releases per two-part run, no unresolved equipment clearance, stock joint limits.
additional_geometry_checks: Post hoc numerical diagnostics are labeled. Run archived nonadjacent-link, bilateral-grip and payload/fixture audits on qualified physical traces; report coverage and unresolved checks explicitly.
failure_policy: Allocate all 24 rows before execution. Record each first-attempt outcome and all retries separately. Preserve partial data. No retuning accepted as first-pass data. Same-code retry permitted for infrastructure faults; a changed implementation requires a new versioned run series. Exclude technical failure from endpoint numerators but retain it in planned counts.
interpretation: Purposeful two-sided boundary examples excluding the ambiguous exact tolerance endpoint; no population reliability or real hardware transfer inference. Historical 33.000/33.600 mm demonstration excluded. Sources and protocol hashed before first native launch.
